title: R&B Vibes
description: Popular R&B artists are showcased.

title: Today's Top Hits
description: Check out the most popular current hits.

title: Hip Hop Heavyweights!
description: Check out some of the biggest players in Hip Hop...it's MTV Music's Hip Hop Heavyweights!

title: Deliver Us From Eva
description: In order to get a breather from their meddling sister-in-law (Gabrielle Union), three men pay a playboy (LL Cool J) $5,000 to romance her.

title: Glory
description: Col. Robert Gould Shaw (Matthew Broderick) trains and leads an all-black regiment during the U.S. Civil War.

title: Lethal Legacy
description: After the mysterious death of a wealthy businessman, his last living relative, Anna, learns she is the sole heir to his inheritance. However, Anna's life gets upended as those around her start getting murdered.

title: Sacrifice
description: A savvy attorney in LA's music industry butts heads with a district attorney as she goes to great lengths to protect her clients.

title: Big Fifty: The DelRhonda Hood Story
description: The story of Delrhonda "Big Fifty" Hood, who goes from running her own drug empire in Detroit to finding redemption.

title: Call Her King
description: Judge Jaeda King has just sentenced Sean Samuels to death when the courthouse is hijacked by Samuels' brother Gabriel, also known as Black Caesar. The judge must rely on her wits, strength and skill to find a way to end the standoff.

title: The First Lady of BMF: The Tonesa Welch Story
description: Detroit native Tonesa Welch rises from teen mom to drug dealer in a harrowing story of riches, remorse, personal responsibility and redemption amid the lavishness and extreme violence of Detroit's crack era.

title: Keys to the City
description: Russell Savage, a widower, is running to become the youngest Mayor in the history of Atlanta. His opponent is August King, the man who raised Russell.

title: Miles Ahead
description: In the 1970s, down-and-out jazz trumpeter Miles Davis (Don Cheadle) tries to recover his new session tape from music producers.
